name: Search field
summary: A search input with a leading icon, an optional clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut hint.
description: Built on the input group. The clear button shows only while there is text, and the shortcut hint hides while the field is focused or filled. The hint is a visual cue: binding the shortcut key is up to the page.

classes.name: v-search
classes.description: Goes on the .v-input-group. Hides the browser's own clear button and quietens the icon.

classes.name: v-search-clear
classes.description: The clear button at the end. Hidden while the input is empty.

classes.name: v-search-hint
classes.description: A shortcut hint holding a .v-kbd. Hidden while the field is focused or filled.

classes.name: v-search-pill
classes.description: A fully rounded field, common in headers.

states.description: Required: the clear button and hint use :placeholder-shown to know whether the field is empty.
Tells assistive tech which shortcut focuses the field, matching the visible hint.
Set on the clear button by the JS while there is nothing to clear.

hooks.name: data-v-clear
hooks.description: Its first button empties the input, returns focus to it and fires input so live filters update.

hooks.name: data-v-shortcut
hooks.description: Pressing the key anywhere on the page focuses the field, unless focus is already in a text field. Pair it with aria-keyshortcuts and a visible .v-search-hint.

keyboard.action: Moves to the input, then to the clear button when there is text.
On the clear button: empties the field and puts focus back in it.
Clears a search input in most browsers (native behaviour).

a11y: Keep a visible label, or at least an aria-label on the input; the icon is decoration and is aria-hidden.
The clear button needs a name (aria-label="Clear search").
The shortcut hint is aria-hidden; put the same key in aria-keyshortcuts on the input, and bind it in your own script.
Put the field in a role="search" landmark (or a <search> element) when it searches the whole site.
